prompts.cover: Use case: text-localization. Edit supplied original and approved M7-01 cover reference into the next series cover. Preserve deep navy textured background, luminous cyan/green bottom ribbon, lower-left feather emblem, right-aligned large white title, left negative space, overall landscape aspect about 1.805:1. No extra illustrations or diagrams. Bottom-right tagline exactly “一个真实系统七端实战”. Crisp correct Chinese typography. Replace old headline and series line with the specified text; do not retain M0-01 or M7-01. Headline two lines “React 与 Vue” / “重写复盘”. Series line “M7-24｜成为全栈·Vue 管理后台篇”.
prompts.shared-contract: Use case: infographic-diagram. One landscape Chinese technical blog interior infographic, aspect about 1.805:1. Reference images define the approved series style: deep royal navy blue, clean white Chinese typography, cyan-to-green borders, very subtle luminous bottom ribbon and small feather emblem lower left. Use generous spacing, clear readable short labels, restrained flat cards. Mark with article ID and “示意图”. No fake screenshot, no evidence of passed tests, no checkmarks, no invented brand logos. Only show the specified content. Preserve exact identifiers, correct Chinese. Title “同一契约，两套工程表达”. Corner “M7-24 · 示意图”. Top center card “冻结 OpenAPI v1.12.0” subtext “角色 · 状态 · 分页 · 上传字段”. Two downward arrows to equal-sized columns. Left heading “React”, rows “Zustand”, “React Query”, “React Router”, “Radix / shadcn 风格组件”. Right heading “Vue”, rows “Pinia”, “Vue Query”, “Vue Router”, “Naive UI”. Both feed bottom center card “对齐业务行为与错误语义”. Footer “类型生成不等于运行时验证；此对照不构成框架排名”. No competition trophy or performance numbers.
